name: upload_link_create
title: Create an upload link
description: Creates a hosted BitterClip upload link for local audio or video files. Use this when the user wants a link or another camera operator will contribute later. capture_session_id adds multiple files or a whole device folder to one footage-session chronology. A link cannot add files directly to an existing episode; files reach one through a footage session for that episode and its capture_session_id.

project_id.description: Optional project public ID, slug, or name to attach uploads to; absent means the default uploads project.

capture_session_id.description: Optional footage-session public ID. Every uploaded file joins that session and triggers incremental chronology analysis.

mode.description: "upload_link" when a shareable upload link is returned.

upload_url.description: The token-gated drop-zone page URL for the user.

project.description: The resolved project the uploads land in, or null for the default project.
